tasks.short: Give management a clear picture of results, cash and financial risks across our three sites.

today.trigger: The monthly reporting timetable or a management request for an update.
steps: Pull balances and transaction detail from AFAS and check the nightly Power BI refresh.
Combine actuals with the Controller's budget and FP&A's latest forecast in Excel.
Investigate movements in revenue, payroll, agency costs, debtors and cash by site.
Write explanations and assemble the management pack.
Review the pack with the Controller and discuss it with management.
drudgery: Copying the same figures into several reports
today.time_sinks: Reconciling different report versions and chasing explanations for movements that the ledger alone cannot explain.

lenses.faster: A reconciled reporting dataset produces the tables and variance bridges automatically. AI drafts commentary from calculated movements and approved explanations, removing spreadsheet copying and first drafts.
lenses.autonomous: A successful refresh generates a draft pack and routes unresolved variances to their owners. Failed reconciliations block release.
lenses.ambitious: Give each site a weekly view of cash, agency expenditure and emerging forecast risks, with clear data timestamps. Add operational explanations when reliable volume and productivity data become available.
lenses.joy: Remove formatting and repeated number checks. Keep the investigation and conversations that help managers understand what changed.
lenses.options: Produce management, site-manager and cash-focused views from the same figures. Show alternative explanations as questions until supporting evidence confirms them.
lenses.altitude: Own the reporting definitions, materiality thresholds and quality checks instead of rebuilding the pack.
reach: Controller: routine variance bridges
FP&A Analyst: actuals commentary and forecast input validation
Credit and Collections Officer: debtor ageing summaries

tasks.human_edge: Recognising when a mathematically correct explanation misses an operational problem, and challenging managers without damaging trust.
tasks.pattern_why: The workflow combines deterministic calculations, evidence retrieval and narrative drafting. A person approves explanations and release because financial movements do not establish their causes.

in_practice.trigger: Successful AFAS extract and Power BI refresh at the reporting cutoff.
steps: Freeze a dated dataset and reconcile report totals to the AFAS trial balance.
Calculate approved metrics, site comparisons and variance bridges using versioned rules.
Retrieve approved explanations and draft commentary with links to supporting records.
Route missing explanations and material exceptions through Teams.
Present the checked pack for approval and archive the released version.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant checks unsupported explanations and material movements; the Controller approves management release.
systems: Proposed reporting workflow and approved language-model service
data_needed: Trial balance and ledger transactions with reporting dimensions
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint reporting register containing dataset timestamps, reconciliations, source links, draft versions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports scheduled refresh and refresh history; this supports dependable reporting inputs, not automatic financial explanations.
The proposed 65% reduction in human effort and 2.5 times end-to-end speed are untested estimates for Noordhaven.

risks: The nightly extract can omit late close entries; every pack needs an explicit cutoff and refresh timestamp.
AI can invent causes for movements; commentary must distinguish confirmed explanations from unanswered questions.
Payroll and agency-cost detail can expose personal data; use aggregated reporting and restricted access under AVG/GDPR.
Faster pack production will not shorten the month close if unresolved postings remain on its critical path.
research_questions: Can site totals and every reported metric reconcile automatically to AFAS?
How much current reporting time is copying and drafting versus investigating causes?
Are budget, forecast and operational explanations stored in stable, accessible formats?
Does a three-month parallel run maintain management trust while reducing preparation and review time?

tasks.short: Calculate our taxes and prepare returns with figures that tie back to AFAS.

today.trigger: A VAT filing deadline, annual corporate tax preparation or a tax correction.
steps: Extract ledger balances, VAT codes and supporting invoices from AFAS.
Reconcile tax control accounts and investigate unusual or missing tax treatments.
Prepare calculations and return workings in Excel or the existing filing channel.
Review complex treatments with the Controller or external tax adviser.
Submit the approved return and arrange separately authorised payment.
systems: Existing tax filing channel, to confirm
today.time_sinks: Resolving inconsistent VAT coding and gathering support for cross-border transport or unusual transactions.

lenses.faster: Versioned rules calculate return figures and reconcile them to the ledger. AI extracts relevant invoice or contract facts for review, removing rekeying and routine document searches.
lenses.autonomous: The filing calendar starts preparation after the period is complete. Missing evidence, new transaction types and reconciliation failures enter an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Check VAT coding throughout the month and maintain a current tax cash forecast. Catch recurring problems before the filing deadline.
lenses.joy: Remove arithmetic and form copying. Keep the investigation of unusual transactions and the satisfaction of a defensible return.
lenses.options: Compare adviser-approved treatments for genuinely uncertain transactions and show their cash consequences. The system must not select the lowest tax amount merely because it is cheaper.
lenses.altitude: Maintain tax mappings, test cases and evidence requirements instead of recalculating each return.
reach: Bookkeeper: tax-code exception checking
Controller: tax-account reconciliations
FP&A Analyst: tax payment timing inputs

tasks.human_edge: Interpreting unusual transactions, recognising missing facts and accepting responsibility for the position submitted.
tasks.pattern_why: Deterministic software should perform tax arithmetic. Document extraction and exception handling need several steps, with approval before filing or payment.

in_practice.trigger: Tax calendar milestone and a reconciled accounting-period snapshot.
steps: Retrieve ledger, tax-code and invoice data through authorised exports or connectors.
Apply reviewed rules for the relevant tax type and period, then reconcile calculated totals.
Extract supporting facts from exception documents and flag uncertain treatments.
Generate the return workings and proposed filing figures for review.
After approval, use the confirmed filing channel and record its receipt; route payment through existing bank authorisation.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant approves every return; the Controller or tax adviser reviews material uncertainty. Existing Rabobank payment approval remains separate.
data_needed: Ledger transactions, VAT codes and tax-account balances
Period-specific tax rules and approved mappings
Prior returns, corrections and adviser decisions
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint tax file containing rule versions, reconciliations, supporting records, approvals, filing receipts and payment references.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors can retrieve configured Profit records and fields; tax calculation and filing still require separate verified capabilities.
A rule-based tax workflow with document extraction is plausible, but the proposed savings and filing integration are untested here.

risks: Incorrect tax codes can produce a consistently wrong return even when every total reconciles.
VAT, corporate income tax and payroll tax need distinct ownership; the Payroll Specialist retains payroll-tax responsibility unless explicitly reassigned.
Rules and filing requirements can change; a model's remembered tax knowledge cannot be the calculation authority.

Preserve checkable tax records under the applicable retention requirements. [Belastingdienst: VAT administration](https://www.belastingdienst.nl/wps/wcm/connect/bldcontentnl/belastingdienst/zakelijk/btw/administratie_bijhouden/)
research_questions: Which tax returns does the Accountant actually own, and which belong to Payroll or an external adviser?
Can the existing filing channel accept validated imports, or does it require manual entry?
What proportion of transactions needs judgement rather than an approved tax mapping?
Can a parallel run reproduce accepted returns and detect known historical coding errors?

tasks.short: Check our assets, debts, income and costs, and investigate balances that do not make sense.

today.trigger: Month-close checks, a material balance movement or a Controller request.
steps: Extract the trial balance, subledgers and supporting schedules.
Reconcile bank, debtors, creditors, payroll and fixed-asset balances.
Compare balances with prior periods and expected site activity.
Investigate mismatches with Bookkeepers, Payroll and site contacts.
Document conclusions and prepare any correcting journals for approval.
today.time_sinks: Tracing unmatched entries and obtaining evidence for accruals, asset movements and agency costs.

lenses.faster: Rules perform reconciliations, roll balances forward and identify unmatched items. The Accountant starts with an evidence-linked exception list.
lenses.autonomous: Each successful extract reruns the checks and clears items that meet approved matching rules. Material differences and missing source files remain open.
lenses.ambitious: Run balance checks daily so close problems emerge during the month. Cover all transactions with basic checks while retaining deeper reviews of material accounts.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive matching and checking of unchanged accounts. Keep finding the operational reason behind unusual balances.
lenses.options: Compare accrual or recoverability scenarios using explicit assumptions. Show which evidence would support each outcome.
lenses.altitude: Own the reconciliation rules, account coverage and exception quality rather than each individual matching exercise.
reach: Bookkeeper: routine subledger reconciliations
Payroll Specialist: payroll-to-ledger reconciliation support
Controller: balance-sheet review preparation

tasks.human_edge: Judging whether a balance represents economic reality, especially for provisions, recoverability and incomplete liabilities.
tasks.pattern_why: Matching, roll-forwards and accounting identities have structured inputs and checkable outputs. AI can help build the checks; routine execution does not need a model.

in_practice.trigger: Successful nightly extract or an approved close-period rerun.
steps: Validate file completeness, accounting periods and control totals.
Run versioned reconciliations and approved matching rules.
Create exceptions with transaction references, amounts, age and supporting evidence.
Route exceptions to the Accountant or source owner and retain their resolution.
Rerun checks after corrections and record the resulting account status.
in_practice.human_gate: Routine reconciliations run without individual approval; the Accountant resolves material exceptions and approves accounting conclusions. Correcting journals follow existing approval rules.
data_needed: Asset schedules, matching rules and materiality thresholds
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted reconciliation register with source identifiers, rule versions, matched items, unresolved differences and resolution approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports configured data retrieval through GetConnectors, providing a possible input to an external reconciliation workflow.
Rules can automate exact matching and balance identities; they cannot establish the completeness of liabilities without sufficient source evidence.
The 60% effort saving and twofold end-to-end speed are hypotheses pending a reconciliation pilot.

risks: Matching tolerances can conceal errors if applied without account-specific approval.
Agency invoices and approved hours may arrive after the extract; missing invoices must not imply no liability.
Unusual movements are investigation prompts, not proof of an accounting error.
Payroll checks need posting totals and authorised supporting data, not unrestricted absence or medical records.
research_questions: Do bank, payroll and agency records contain stable references that support reliable matching?
Which accounts consume the most review time, and what causes their exceptions?
Can the workflow detect known errors without clearing material differences incorrectly?
How much resolution time remains dependent on external agencies or site contacts?

tasks.short: Write clear reports on financial control findings, with evidence, impact and agreed follow-up.

today.trigger: Completion of an internal financial review or receipt of findings from the external auditor.
steps: Collect working papers, transaction evidence and review notes.
Separate confirmed findings from unresolved observations.
Describe each issue, supporting evidence, financial impact and proposed action.
Discuss factual accuracy and action ownership with the relevant manager.
Obtain review approval and record actions and deadlines.
drudgery: Turning scattered notes into a consistent report
today.time_sinks: Resolving ambiguous notes and repeatedly revising wording while agreeing what the evidence actually establishes.

lenses.faster: AI turns approved finding records into a consistent report with evidence links. Rules populate the action register, removing formatting and duplicate entry.
lenses.autonomous: A finding marked ready for drafting generates a report section and checks for missing evidence, owner or deadline. Publication waits for approval.
lenses.ambitious: Track repeat findings across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo, and verify whether fixes remain effective. Make recurring close adjustments visible as control problems.
lenses.joy: Remove report assembly and repetitive wording changes. Keep making findings fair, understandable and useful.
lenses.options: Draft a management summary, a detailed evidence appendix and alternative action proposals. Each version uses the same approved facts.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the finding standard and assess whether reporting leads to effective corrective action.
reach: Controller: internal-control action tracking
Finance Director: audit committee or management briefing preparation
Bookkeeper: documenting recurring processing failures

tasks.human_edge: Distinguishing a defensible finding from an allegation, assessing severity and agreeing remedies that people can implement.
tasks.pattern_why: The model's bounded job is to convert approved evidence and finding records into prose. Deterministic completeness checks and human approval surround that drafting step.

in_practice.trigger: An approved finding record enters the reporting queue.
steps: Collect only authorised evidence and structured finding fields.
Check that each finding has a criterion, observation, evidence and proposed action.
Draft report sections without adding unsupported causes, amounts or conclusions.
Have the Accountant verify factual accuracy and the Controller approve severity and release.
Publish the approved report and populate its action tracker.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant verifies every finding and citation; the Controller approves the report. External auditors retain ownership of their independent opinions.
data_needed: Approved review scope and finding template
in_practice.logs_to: The restricted SharePoint review file, preserving source evidence, generated drafts, edits, approvals and action history.

evidence.claim: Language models can draft structured reports from supplied notes, but source checking and judgement remain necessary.
The proposed evidence-linked drafting workflow and its savings have not been demonstrated at Noordhaven.

risks: A fluent report can overstate what a sample or interview proves.
Invented evidence references or financial impacts could make a finding indefensible.
Sensitive allegations and worker information require restricted access and purpose-limited processing.
Drafting assistance does not confer statutory audit authority on an internal Accountant.
research_questions: Are findings already captured in structured records, or would substantial preparation still be needed?
Can reviewers trace every factual statement to evidence without increasing review time?
Do generated reports preserve uncertainty and sample limitations accurately?
Does the workflow reduce drafting effort without increasing corrections or disputed findings?

tasks.short: Assess how our assets, financing and accounting adjustments affect taxable profit and tax liabilities.

today.trigger: A monthly tax provision, annual corporate tax preparation, asset purchase, disposal or financing change.
steps: Gather asset schedules, financing agreements and relevant ledger balances.
Identify differences between accounting treatment and tax treatment.
Calculate depreciation, interest and valuation effects in Excel.
Discuss uncertain positions and assumptions with the Controller or tax adviser.
Document the accepted calculation for provisions and subsequent return preparation.
today.time_sinks: Establishing the correct treatment and obtaining reliable asset histories or financing terms.

lenses.faster: Rules calculate schedules from approved assumptions; AI extracts contract terms for verification. Routine recalculation disappears.
lenses.autonomous: An asset or financing change refreshes the draft tax bridge and identifies missing facts. New tax positions require review.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a rolling tax forecast and compare the tax cash effects of planned fleet or warehouse investments. Include only asset and financing categories Noordhaven actually holds.
lenses.joy: Remove schedule maintenance and repeated arithmetic. Keep examining transactions and explaining their financial consequences.
lenses.options: Compare supported purchase, lease and financing scenarios using adviser-reviewed treatments. Show sensitivity to residual values, useful lives and interest assumptions.
lenses.altitude: Own the assumptions, accounting-to-tax bridge and review process rather than individual valuation spreadsheets.
reach: Controller: tax provision support
FP&A Analyst: investment and financing scenarios
Finance Director: tax cash planning inputs

tasks.human_edge: Choosing defensible assumptions and recognising when a complex transaction requires specialist tax advice.
tasks.pattern_why: Contract extraction, schedule calculation and tax-position documentation span several steps. Arithmetic is deterministic, while treatment and assumption approval remain human.

in_practice.trigger: A relevant asset or financing change, or the monthly tax-provision timetable.
steps: Retrieve the asset history, financing documents and accounting balances.
Extract terms into structured fields and flag missing or conflicting evidence.
Apply approved accounting and tax rules in separate, versioned schedules.
Generate the tax bridge and requested scenarios with explicit assumptions.
Obtain approval before using the result in provisions or passing it to return preparation.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant verifies extracted terms; the Controller or tax adviser approves material assumptions and tax treatments.
data_needed: Asset cost, acquisition date, disposal history and residual-value assumptions
Financing agreements and verified interest terms
Approved tax adjustments and applicable rule versions
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint tax-valuation file containing contract references, verified terms, rule versions, scenario assumptions and approvals.

evidence.claim: Approved depreciation, interest and present-value assumptions can be executed in deterministic calculation schedules.
The relevance of this O*NET task and the proposed savings depend on Noordhaven's actual asset holdings, financing and adviser arrangements.

risks: The O*NET references to stocks, bonds, annuities and depletable assets may have little relevance to this logistics company.
Accounting depreciation and fiscal depreciation must remain distinct; a model must not infer tax treatment from book treatment.
Extracted contract terms can omit amendments, options or conditions that change the calculation.
Tax analysis and return preparation overlap; savings for this task and the tax-return task must not be counted twice.
research_questions: Which asset, financing and valuation calculations are actually performed internally?
Are tax schedules maintained by Noordhaven or by its external adviser?
Can verified contract terms and asset histories populate calculations without manual reconstruction?
Would scenario preparation save meaningful time after specialist review and overlap with return preparation?

tasks.short: Check that our finance systems produce reliable numbers and have sensible access and approval controls.

today.trigger: A system change, control failure, audit finding or scheduled control review.
steps: Map data flows between AFAS, bank files, agency portals and Power BI.
Review permissions, approval arrangements and interface checks.
Sample transactions and trace them from source to ledger and report.
Discuss weaknesses and practical remedies with Finance and system owners.
Recommend controls and verify implementation.
today.time_sinks: Obtaining complete configuration evidence and establishing whether documented controls operate in practice.

lenses.faster: Rules compare access exports against approved role combinations and reconcile interfaces. AI organises evidence and drafts control recommendations for the Accountant to assess.
lenses.autonomous: Scheduled checks detect changed permissions, failed extracts and missing control evidence. They notify owners without changing permissions or declaring controls effective.
lenses.ambitious: Monitor key finance controls continuously, including automation failures and unexplained overrides. Test whether finance reports remain reliable after system changes.
lenses.joy: Remove screenshot collection and repetitive comparisons. Keep understanding failure modes and designing controls people can follow.
lenses.options: Compare preventive and detective controls, including their effort and effect on close speed. Simulate how proposed approval rules affect real transaction paths.
lenses.altitude: Design and evaluate the finance control framework, including the controls around automated work.
reach: Controller: control design and monitoring
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: payroll-interface data checks
Finance Director: finance automation assurance

tasks.human_edge: Judging whether controls address the real risk, balancing operational needs and maintaining independent challenge.
tasks.pattern_why: Software can collect and compare evidence, but reliable control design requires judgement about process, incentives, access and practical operation.

in_practice.trigger: A control-review schedule, system change or automated failure alert.
steps: Collect authorised configurations, access exports and interface control totals.
Run approved permission-conflict and completeness checks.
Prepare an evidence-linked briefing with gaps and alternative controls.
Have the Accountant validate the issue through transaction tracing and owner discussions.
Obtain owner approval for changes and independently verify their operation.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant evaluates findings; accountable system and finance owners approve changes. Independent review is needed when the Accountant designed the control being tested.
data_needed: Configuration changes and available activity logs
Evidence of actual approvals and exception handling
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint control register with test scope, evidence, findings, ownership, approved changes and independent verification.

evidence.claim: Power BI exposes refresh history and failure information that can support monitoring of reporting interfaces.
Access-rule comparisons and interface reconciliations can be automated when complete configuration evidence is available.
The proposed reduction in review effort is an untested estimate, not evidence that controls become effective automatically.

risks: Incomplete exports can conceal access conflicts or approval bypasses.
Broadly privileged automation accounts can weaken segregation of duties.

Changes to arrangements that can monitor workers may require OR consent; review the proposed purpose and capability. [Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens: Staff tracking systems](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/ondernemingsraad/de-or-en-personeelsvolgsystemen)

If AI is repurposed to evaluate workers or influence employment decisions, assess the EU AI Act classification for that intended use. [European Commission: Navigating the AI Act](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)
research_questions: Can each system provide complete, dated access and approval evidence?
Which controls currently fail, and would automated checks have detected those failures?
Who can independently review controls designed or operated by the Accountants?
Does the proposed monitoring introduce worker-tracking capabilities or employment-related AI uses?

tasks.short: Prepare and check our financial statements and annual reporting schedules from the closed ledger.

today.trigger: Monthly statement preparation or the annual reporting and external-audit timetable.
steps: Obtain the trial balance and supporting schedules from AFAS and Excel.
Map accounts into financial statement lines and reconcile movements.
Prepare statement drafts, disclosures and comparative figures.
Check consistency, accounting treatments and links to supporting records.
Resolve review points with the Controller and external auditor before approval.
today.time_sinks: Late journals, missing disclosure evidence and repeated updates across statements and supporting schedules.

lenses.faster: Approved mappings populate statements and schedules, while rules check totals and comparatives. AI drafts disclosures from verified facts and approved accounting policies.
lenses.autonomous: A new approved trial-balance version rebuilds draft statements and identifies changed figures. Missing disclosures and failed checks block approval.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a monthly reporting file that stays ready for annual preparation. Collect disclosure evidence throughout the year instead of searching for it at year end.
lenses.joy: Remove template maintenance and cross-reference repairs. Keep assessing accounting treatments and presenting a faithful financial picture.
lenses.options: Show the effect of alternative supportable estimates for provisions, useful lives and recoverability. Keep approved statements separate from planning scenarios.
lenses.altitude: Own the reporting mappings, disclosure evidence and review controls rather than assemble each statement manually.
reach: Controller: statement consistency checks
FP&A Analyst: reliable historical financial inputs
Finance Director: external-audit information preparation

tasks.human_edge: Determining appropriate accounting treatments, materiality and disclosures, and taking responsibility for the final financial picture.
tasks.pattern_why: Statement construction and checks are deterministic, but disclosure drafting and missing-evidence follow-up span several steps. Accounting decisions and final approval remain human.

in_practice.trigger: An approved trial-balance snapshot for monthly or annual reporting.
steps: Validate the snapshot and apply approved account-to-statement mappings.
Build statements and roll-forwards, then run balance, comparative and cross-reference checks.
Retrieve verified disclosure facts and draft text with evidence links.
Route missing evidence and accounting questions to their owners.
Rebuild after approved adjustments and submit the complete version for review and approval.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant reviews statements and disclosures; the Controller and authorised management approve the final reporting. The external auditor retains independent audit responsibility.
data_needed: Approved trial balance and prior-year comparatives
Asset, debt, provision and equity schedules
Verified disclosure facts and supporting contracts
Adjustment history and applicable reporting framework
in_practice.logs_to: The restricted SharePoint reporting file containing source snapshots, mapping versions, checks, disclosure evidence, adjustments and approvals.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors provide configurable retrieval of Profit data; statement mappings and disclosure workflows require additional implementation.
Statement mapping and arithmetic checks can be automated, while accounting treatments and disclosure completeness require judgement.
The proposed savings and speedup are estimates that need validation across monthly reporting and an annual reporting cycle.

risks: A reconciled ledger does not establish that all liabilities or required disclosures are complete.
Incorrect account mappings can propagate consistently across every statement.
The applicable Dutch reporting framework and filing obligations must be confirmed for this B.V.; company size and consolidation circumstances are not supplied.
Savings overlap with management reporting, balance review and audit-report preparation.
research_questions: Which reporting framework, disclosures and consolidation requirements apply to Noordhaven?
Are account mappings and supporting schedules stable enough to automate?
How much preparation time is template work versus accounting judgement and missing evidence?
Can a parallel reporting cycle reproduce approved statements without increasing reviewer corrections?

tasks.short: Check transaction records and speak with colleagues to understand whether our processes follow the rules.

today.trigger: A compliance review, unexplained transaction, audit request or suspected process failure.
steps: Define the question, relevant rules and records needed.
Select transactions and inspect invoices, approvals, hours or payroll postings.
Interview relevant colleagues about how the process actually worked.
Compare explanations with records and resolve contradictions.
Document conclusions, proposed corrections and matters needing specialist advice.
today.time_sinks: Arranging conversations across shifts and sites, then establishing facts when records and explanations disagree.

lenses.faster: Rules select relevant records and AI prepares an evidence-linked briefing and interview questions. The Accountant spends less time searching and organising notes.
lenses.autonomous: Defined transaction exceptions can trigger preparation of a review file. Interviews, credibility assessments and compliance conclusions stay with the Accountant.
lenses.ambitious: Review recurring failures across all three sites and include night-shift processes. Use findings to improve recording and approvals before they generate close adjustments.
lenses.joy: Remove document chasing and note formatting. Keep listening to colleagues and understanding how work actually happens.
lenses.options: Prepare different questions for a Bookkeeper, shift supervisor or Payroll Specialist. Offer several hypotheses to test, without assigning blame.
lenses.altitude: Design an evidence-based review programme and improve the process from what interviews reveal.
reach: Controller: process walkthroughs and compliance evidence
Payroll Specialist: investigation support for approved-hours and posting differences
HR Business Partner: financial evidence for joint process reviews

tasks.human_edge: Building trust, hearing context that records miss, testing conflicting explanations and making fair conclusions.
tasks.pattern_why: Preparation and note organisation are suitable for assistance. Interviews and conclusions require human presence, judgement and sensitivity.

in_practice.trigger: An Accountant-approved review scope or a defined transaction exception.
steps: Collect the minimum authorised records and applicable policy or CAO provisions.
Prepare a source-linked chronology, transaction sample and questions.
Have the Accountant conduct interviews using clear purpose and appropriate arrangements.
Structure the Accountant's approved notes and distinguish evidence, explanations and unresolved contradictions.
Have the Accountant conclude the review and route specialist questions or corrections to the responsible owner.
in_practice.human_gate: The Accountant controls scope, interviews and conclusions. HR, Payroll or legal advisers assess employment-law and CAO matters within their responsibilities.
data_needed: Approved hours and payroll posting records where necessary
Current policies and relevant CAO provisions
in_practice.logs_to: A restricted SharePoint review file recording scope, accessed evidence, sample rationale, approved notes, conclusions and follow-up ownership.

evidence.claim: AI can assist with document summaries, question drafts and note organisation; it cannot reliably establish credibility or legal compliance from records alone.
The 30% effort saving is an untested preparation estimate; shift scheduling and human conversations limit end-to-end speed.

risks: Transaction anomalies must not become automated accusations or worker performance scores.
Use minimum necessary personal data under AVG/GDPR; financial checks do not require medical details or unrestricted Wet verbetering poortwachter files.

Staff-monitoring arrangements need assessment of OR consent requirements. [Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens: Staff tracking systems](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/ondernemingsraad/de-or-en-personeelsvolgsystemen)

AI used to evaluate workers or influence employment decisions needs a separate intended-purpose assessment under the EU AI Act. [European Commission: Navigating the AI Act](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/faqs/navigating-ai-act)
research_questions: How much review time is document preparation versus interviews and resolving contradictions?
Can access be limited to the records necessary for each approved review?
Do generated briefings preserve conflicting evidence without implying blame?
Can reviews cover all sites and shifts without increasing worker-monitoring capabilities or undermining trust?

role.altitude: The Accountant becomes the owner of reliable financial evidence: designing reconciliations, reporting rules and review gates, then resolving the exceptions that affect close quality and forecast trust.
reach: Controller: routine balance reviews, variance bridges and control monitoring
Bookkeeper: recurring reconciliation and tax-code checks
FP&A Analyst: validated actuals, tax cash inputs and investment scenarios
Payroll Specialist: payroll-to-ledger reconciliation support
Finance Director: management reporting and external-audit evidence preparation
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: financial interface validation with restricted access
role.ceiling_note: The current workflows are inferred working assumptions for this fictional company. These eight tasks total 415 hours per FTE annually, about 26% of the supplied role-time basis. The estimates imply about 432 gross hours across both Accountants, worth roughly EUR 30,000 of capacity at EUR 70/hour, before overlap, implementation and monitoring; they are not cash savings or a headcount recommendation. Time_saved_pct estimates human effort saved; speedup estimates elapsed task time with functioning integrations and existing approval availability. Missing evidence, adviser review and upstream postings can limit both. Do not extrapolate these results to the remaining role or the whole month close.
skills_to_grow: AFAS data extraction, account mappings and reconciliation design
Power Query, SQL and versioned financial calculation rules
Testing completeness, cutoffs and exception thresholds
Evidence-linked AI drafting and efficient review
Dutch tax and reporting judgement, with specialist escalation
Segregation of duties and automation control design
AVG/GDPR data minimisation and assessment of OR and AI Act implications
Explaining financial risks and investigating processes across sites and shifts
role.ambitious_version: Run a continuously checked financial evidence process across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo. Reconcile key balances throughout the month, identify missing agency costs early, keep reporting and tax schedules current, and give FP&A dependable actuals with explicit cutoffs. Measure success through fewer close-blocking exceptions, fewer audit adjustments and a forecast management trusts; expand only where source data and controls support it.
